proposal.name: Fix partial choices, moved projects and watcher shutdown

plan.name: Fix partial choices, moved projects and watcher shutdown
plan.summary: When some forks have valid choices, the factory keeps those choices and their provenance across polls and restarts, takes up a following revise with those choices and the writer's comments without waiting for the remaining forks, and otherwise posts once for each new set of choices which forks still need an answer. Ratification reuses an earlier branch only when its proposal hash and any directory explicitly named by the saved proposal, including an amendment target, match; a changed destination gets a fresh branch from the base, while an implicitly numbered project keeps its earlier allocation when work resumes. SIGTERM and SIGINT cancel watcher steps and each agent run's whole process group, wait for all steps and lease renewal to stop, then relinquish only that watcher's own lease using bounded cleanup independent of the canceled context, allowing another watcher to acquire it immediately. SPEC.md and README.md will describe partial-choice feedback and revision, branch reuse that checks the project directory, and orderly shutdown, with changed SPEC bullets citing the existing decisions they rest on and this ratified plan. This is tested plumbing under D-0105, and whoever merges it must record the decision for these changes because the build cannot write decisions/ (D-0122).

tests.name: TestPartialChoices422ReviseUsesChosenForks
tests.says: Choosing F1 and F3 and then requesting a revise drafts again once with those choices, their provenance, the previous draft and the writer's prose, without inventing or waiting for F2 and without replaying the commands.

tests.name: TestPartialChoices422NamesMissingForkAndRetainsAnswers
tests.says: Partial choices without a revise get one actionable reply naming the remaining fork, and those choices survive idle polls and a watcher restart before either the last choice or a revise resumes drafting.

tests.name: TestRatifyingTheSameStatementsHonorsTheProjectDirectory
tests.says: Ratifying unchanged statements after the project directory changes builds in the new directory on a fresh branch without altering the old branch; an unchanged destination reuses its branch, including an implicit numbered directory after unrelated projects advance the numbering.

tests.name: TestSIGTERMCancelsTheWatcherCommand422
tests.says: SIGTERM reaches the watch command's cancellation path and lets it unwind instead of terminating the watcher before cleanup can run.

tests.name: TestCanceledWatcherReleasesLeaseAfterAllSteps422
tests.says: A canceled watcher retains its lease while any step is draining, makes it immediately available once all steps stop, and never releases a lease another watcher has taken.

tests.name: TestSIGTERMStopsAgentDescendantsAndReleasesLease422
tests.says: SIGTERM during either supported agent backend's run ends the watcher and every process in the fixture agent's tree, including descendants holding its output pipes, and lets a successor take the lease immediately.
